messages:
anna: Heads-up — Console is showing big per-route quota spikes for several customers. Looks correlated with a change in SDK header behavior.
mike: Which header? the old `x-rw-route` or the new `X-Redwood-Billing` thing?
anna: Some requests have `billing_key` and some have `X-Redwood-Billing` depending on client. Mixed casing + different names.
sofia: Ugh. I remember we landed the Python opt-in that renamed the header last quarter. TS was supposed to map both. Go kept the old one for perf reasons.
elaine: Can we confirm if it's just casing or semantically different values? (i.e. different tenant ids vs route tags)
mike: Quick grep in logs shows both: `billing_key=acct:team-123` and `X-Redwood-Billing: route=feature-x;acct=team-123` — JS/TS include route context, py sends just acct.
sofia: That'll break attribution in the dashboard. Console expects a single canonical attribution value to map to cost centers.
anna: Proposing short-term: Console should fallback to heuristics: prefer `X-Redwood-Billing` if present, else `billing_key`, else infer from token. Add note in UI "inferred attribution".
elaine: Agreed for fallback. But we need an SDK migration plan — otherwise explodes when we roll out quota buckets.
mike: For SDKs: py -> add structured `X-Redwood-Billing` opt-in (already behind flag). TS -> normalize both headers into canonical header before sending. Go -> tiny shim to emit canonical header with zero alloc.
sofia: I can do the TS change today. Patch will look like:

```
const hdr = req.headers['x-redwood-billing'] || req.headers['billing_key'];
req.headers['X-Redwood-Billing'] = normalize(hdr);
```

anna: Nice. Add test for mixed-case headers and one for route tag parsing.
sofia: Will do. Mike, can you coordinate the Go shim? We need backwards-compatible behavior: keep accepting old header but always add canonical one.
mike: Yep, I'll open a tiny PR. ETA EOD. Go shim will be an opt-in env var in the release so infra can toggle if anything weird.
elaine: Console UX: I'll add a toggle in the quota dashboard header to show "Attribution source: canonical | fallback | inferred" and a tooltip explaining heuristics.
anna: Also add a short alert to the Console release notes and a support playbook: if customers see sudden cost movement, check header mix.
deploy-bot: deploy noted: canary rollout for console toggle scheduled at 2026-03-24T16:00Z, 10% -> 50% -> 100% on success :rocket:
sofia: I'll coordinate the TS patch with DevEx release. Once PRs pass, let's run a synthetic that hits both old and new header shapes and confirm dashboard attribution stabilizes.
anna: Thanks team — action items: Sofia (TS PR), Mike (Go shim PR + env opt-in), Elaine (Console toggle + tooltip + release note). I'll draft the support blurb.
mike: Putting PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
sofia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-ts/pull/482 — includes tests and migration note.
anna: That looks good. Follow-up in ~24h to verify metrics.
